title: Published address set of one fleet machine: every reachable non-loopback, non-link-local address of its interfaces, identified by origin and never by address

Address.description: One address of one interface. `scope` says how far it reaches: `private` (RFC 1918 or shared address space), `unique-local` (IPv6 fc00::/7) or `global`. `prefix` is the length of its network, which decides `same subnet first` for a client.

description: Written atomically to `<store>/v1/origins/<origin>/addresses.json` by the machine itself and rewritten whenever its interfaces change or the freshness stamp passes half of `ttlMs`. A reader treats the set as stale once `observedAtMs + ttlMs` has passed and then tries DNS-SD discovery of the instance named by the origin before the addresses.

origin.description: The origin id, the one identity of the machine; it names the DNS-SD instance of type `_semio-fleet._tcp` that the machine advertises.

name.description: The fleet name `semio-<origin>`, derived from the origin id and never from the host name of the operating system.

hostLabel.description: The first label of the operating system host name, lower case, kept only so that duplicates can be noticed; never an identity and never connected to.

advertise.description: Whether the machine advertises itself through DNS-SD (type `_semio-fleet._tcp`, TXT origin and roles). It stays silent while another origin carries the same host name label (or the same label with the numeric suffix macOS appends on a conflict); `duplicates` names those origins.

namedAs.description: The origin whose semantic host name `semio-<origin>` this machine carries although it is another origin (a copy-paste rename); null when the name is not another origin's.
